description: Frozen selection of 200 Combat and 100 Harvest tasks: an initial 200-task selection retained in order, plus 80 Combat and 20 Harvest tasks selected from recorded-success and observed-zero pools with feature diversity.

seed_protocol.semantics: Use the existing deterministic per-task/trial world and task seeds; default trial indices are 0 through 7.

selection_method.algorithm: Greedy weighted unseen-feature coverage; then weighted inverse-frequency coverage within the new group; then inverse-frequency coverage of all retained tasks. SHA256(seed:group:task_id) breaks ties. Not uniform random sampling.
selection_method.diversity_reference: Same-category retained tasks including preceding addition groups
selection_method.zero_pool_rule: Exclude every task with observed success in either full-suite model, not only success tasks selected into this suite

outcome_evidence.success_rule: JarvisVLA >=1/8 OR GameWAM >=1/8; remaining full-panel tasks observed 0/8 in both

difficulty_rubric.scope: Retain parent ratings unchanged; new tasks are unclassified. Zero observed successes is not a difficulty label.

paper_relationship.limitation: Observed-outcome-selected panel, not an unbiased held-out benchmark.
